test_title: PYST 2: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are seated in a row, facing north. Only 2 people sit to the right of G. Only three people sit between B and G. E sits fourth to the left of C, and is an immediate neighbour of both B and A. D is not an immediate neighbour of B. D sits third to the right of H. Who sits at the extreme right end of the row?
solution: From the given information: Step 1: Only 2 people sit to the right of G. Only three people sit between B and G. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb3802a8030c62dcfd0a2824d344fa43e2b0cd44b8d8c45f56e0e51f5fa88b8b.png] We place G such that there are 2 spots left at its right & then we place B leaving 3 spots between B and G. Step 2: E sits fourth to the left of C, and is an immediate neighbour of both B and A.
